evidence.title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Bringing Real-Time Generative Simulation to Surgical Robotics

summary: NVIDIA introduces Cosmos-H-Dreams, a platform enabling real-time generative simulation to enhance surgical robotics. The technology aims to improve precision and training in medical procedures through advanced AI.
title: NVIDIA Unveils Cosmos-H-Dreams for Real-Time AI Simulation in Surgical Robotics
